stemMd: Why were the photographs helpful but insufficient?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They made the construction note irrelevant

options.label: B
options.textMd: They documented some altered rows without showing the whole auditorium

options.label: C
options.textMd: They necessarily showed the architect’s initial intention

options.label: D
options.textMd: They contained no evidence about seating

explanationMd: The photographs supplied evidence of actual conditions after opening, but only within their field of view. Their value and limitation coexist. They support specific revisions without certifying every part of the reconstruction.

distractorRationale.c: They were taken after opening and recorded visible results.
distractorRationale.a: The sources could inform one another.
